matches.rationale: The ground-truth defect concerns Theorem 3.3's unjustified assumption that A(0)=A(T); none of the six findings mention Theorem 3.3 or this identification-of-area issue, instead targeting equation (2.1), (2.5), Proposition 3.1, Theorem 3.2, and Remark 2.2.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a distinct algebraic inconsistency in the area-preserving flow claim (Sec. 2.1), unrelated to the Theorem 3.3 defect.
Points to a separate issue with the definition and differentiability of I_A in Theorem 2.3/eq. (2.5), not the Theorem 3.3 assumption.
Highlights an internal inconsistency in Proposition 3.1's small-area asymptotics, a different locus from the ground truth.
Addresses a flawed inequality step in the proof of Theorem 3.2, unrelated to the A(0)=A(T) assumption in Theorem 3.3.
Targets the curvature decay estimate in Theorem 3.2, a separate mathematical claim from the ground-truth defect.
Critiques an algebraic expansion error in Remark 2.2, which is unrelated to the Theorem 3.3 area-equality assumption.
